requiredEvidence: Route-bound optional borehole and structural artifacts
decisionLogic: Render the measured terrain, mapped surface-unit strips, interval-censored transition bands, borehole sticks and apparent-dip symbols; fill all unmodelled subsurface with UNKNOWN and never join isolated evidence into contacts.
uncertainty: A borehole with unauthorized absolute elevation is labelled as reported-Z context and outlined in red.
exclusions: No surface continuation from dip symbols
No conversion of mapped surface units into subsurface contacts
validationMethod: Hash mutation, canvas boundary, UNKNOWN fill, unverified-elevation and no-lateral-interpolation tests plus actual V40 render inspection
reopenCondition: Reopen for uncertainty bands, reviewed surface polygons, publication typography or vector/DWG output.
